summary: Onboarding request: audit-mirror sampling with signed resume-token and billing ledger crosswalk
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a one-time onboarding delivery and recurring mirror of tenant-scoped audit events into their SIEM. They require: (1) per-batch signed manifests (ed25519) and a resume-token to allow resumable replay, (2) a sample package for legal-hold verification with PII-redaction metadata, and (3) a crosswalk mapping between our usage ledger (per-token billing) and the exported events for reconciliation with their finance team.

Impact: Fintera cannot complete their internal SOC onboarding and legal-hold verification without signed artifacts. This blocks go-live for their Redwood-based compliance pipeline.

Environment: prod us-east (customer's tenant: fintera-prod-3).

Requested deliverables: signed batch manifest schema, example sample slice (1 hour, UTC 2026-03-01T14:00Z window) with resume token, S3 presigned delivery or SFTP with delivery receipts, and a CSV crosswalk mapping event IDs to billing ledger IDs for the same time window.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer requests: provide a reproducible sample of the export and manifest for their compliance team.
2) Support should produce a one-hour sample export (UTC window noted above) containing: per-event header (event_id, tenant_id, timestamp), a per-batch manifest signed with our signing key, and a resume token that can be used to request the next batch.
3) Verify signature by publishing public key and sample verification command.
4) Provide a separate CSV mapping: event_id -> billing_record_id and cost_token_count.
5) Provide instructions for automated daily deliveries via SFTP with ack receipts.
investigation_notes:
Initial triage (2026-03-10): CS verified Fintera's compliance checklist and requested signed-manifest support (ed25519). Confirmed no existing automated export exactly matching their requested crosswalk format.

Hypotheses: 1) We can generate a one-off sample using the export pipeline + manifest signing (small code change to include billing_record_id in CSV crosswalk). 2) Resume-token format is already emitted for ordered webhooks; sample needs to convert internal token to opaque token expected by customer's replay harness.

Checks performed: - Confirmed manifest signing key exists in KMS (auth lead confirmed). - Verified that the export pipeline writes per-event billing_record_id into debug logs for the time window. - Locally ran the export generator for a 10-minute window and produced a signed manifest; signature verified with staging public key.

Open blockers: Need an SRE/infra ops run (PR + deploy) to enable the one-off sample job and a short-lived presigned S3 path or ephemeral SFTP account for Fintera. Also need an ops-approved CSV mapping utility to join event stream -> billing ledger (privacy review needed for PII fields).

resolution:
Workaround/Deliverable: Delivered a one-hour sample bundle to s3://redwood-onboarding/fintera/samples/2026-03-01-14-00/ containing: (a) per-event JSON slices with event_id and billing_record_id, (b) signed batch manifest (ed25519) including request_id and resume_token, and (c) human-readable CSV crosswalk for finance.

Permanent fix / next steps: (1) Create an onboarding automation playbook (Confluence) and a self-serve toggle in Console to enable daily signed-mirror deliveries for enterprise tenants (follow-up ticket INT-78321). (2) Add an internal job to rotate signing-key every 90 days and publish the key rotation schedule to the customer's onboarding doc. (3) Product/Compliance to publish the manifest schema and verification cli in the public support repo.

Status: Delivered sample and validated by customer; ticket will remain open until playbook + key-rotation items are complete (tracking in linked issues).
customer_acknowledgement: 2026-03-12: Fintera SOC (Nora) confirmed successful signature verification and billing reconciliation test. Customer requests playbook and automated delivery; escalated to product for self-serve option.
